market_view: Re-run after capital raised to EUR 5,000 / 8 slots, with the Athens Exchange now in the screen. Screen as of 11-24 (refreshed): breadth 45.5% above SMA200, VWCE.DE only +0.4% and SXR8.DE +2.1% above SMA200, EQQQ.DE -3.3% below: still a normal regime but with a thin cushion, so I add only two moderate-size, low-volatility ideas and keep most cash. Greek banks pulled back 5-9% this week after strong 9M results; of the 27 Greek names the cleanest trends with sufficient liquidity are Bank of Cyprus and Jumbo. Optima (best Greek momentum) fails the EUR 5m liquidity rule; GEK Terna has 9M results still due. These are created after today's EU cutoff, so they fill at tomorrow's 10:00 Athens open (cap 2 buys/day; today's 2 are IBE.MC and PG).

proposals.thesis: Bank of Cyprus reported 9M-2026 profit of EUR 383m (+9%), RoTE 18.9%, and raised 2026 RoTE guidance to high-teens with a 70% payout plus up to 20% top-up. Screen 11-24: close 10.69, 2.7% off 52w high, +8.0% vs SMA200, above SMA50, RSI 51, volatility 26%, ADV EUR 6.2m. Adds Greek/Cypriot financials; next results with FY in February.
proposals.risks: Rate cuts compress net interest income; Greek bank selloff this week could extend; liquidity is only just above the engine's minimum; close below SMA50 (~10.6) weakens the trend.

proposals.thesis: Jumbo's Jan-Oct 2026 group sales rose 6.7% with October +13% (best month of the year, Greece +9% YTD); the EUR 1.00 special dividend already went ex on 16 Nov, so no distribution drop ahead. Screen 11-24: close 26.84, +9.6% vs SMA200, above SMA50, RSI 46, 6% off 52w high, very low 17% volatility, ADV EUR 8.6m. Defensive consumer name that diversifies away from banks.
proposals.risks: Momentum is modest (20d -1.5%); Romania sales weak; consumer slowdown or a weak Christmas season; a close below SMA50 (~26.3) would break the setup.
